title: Seragam Jangan Dicuci
subject: a girl on her last day of SMA whose white uniform shirt is covered in friends' marker signatures, hiding it in her cupboard so her mother will not put it in the wash
caption: Indonesian whimsical harp folk-pop in the vein of mid-2020s Jakarta storyteller folk. Concert harp playing rippling arpeggios, a small glockenspiel melody, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, soft brushed snare, long cello lines. Soft airy mix with gentle plate reverb. Female mezzo-soprano, airy intimate storytelling delivery with clear diction. 92 BPM, A major. Bittersweet, light, nostalgic. No autotune, no trap beat, no EDM build, no power ballad drums, no belting.
lyrics:
[Intro - harp and glockenspiel]

[Verse 1]
Seragam putih hari terakhir
Penuh spidol warna-warni
Ada nama Dinda di kerah
Ada gambar kucing Bima

[Pre-Chorus]
Ibu panggil dari belakang
Mana bajumu, mau dicuci

[Chorus]
Jangan dicuci, Bu
Biar kotor di lemari
Tulisan ini nggak bisa
Ditulis ulang lagi

[Verse 2]
Pak Darto tulis jangan bolos
Pakai huruf besar miring
Lukman cuma tulis nomor
Yang belum pernah kutelepon

[Bridge - harp alone]
Kulipat pelan di rak atas
Di bawah selimut tebal

[Chorus]
Jangan dicuci, Bu
Biar kotor di lemari
Malam ini kubuka lagi
Nomornya kucoba nanti

[Outro - harp and cello fade]
